long_biography.plain_text:
Argiris Karras’s work at Aluminco spans factory management and the design of fittings for glass balustrades. In 2010, he filed two patent applications for systems that secure glass panels with shaped profiles and screws. One allowed the balustrade’s base to sit within the floor; the other mounted it on top.

As chief executive, Karras announced Aluminco’s purchase of Doral’s factory at Kalochori, near Thessaloniki, in 2021. The plant had stood largely idle for eight years. Acquired at auction, it formed the basis of plans to expand the company’s manufacturing capacity. He proposed reopening the factory and modernising it over five years.
